g.text: School board rates fell in all 67 counties from 1997 to 2025; county rates fell less
Adopted millage, 1996–2025; every Florida county or city as a thin grey line, shared scale. Gaps are
left blank, never interpolated; no values are held over.
Source: Florida Office of Economic & Demographic Research and Florida Department of Revenue, via the
openmillage Florida millage history dataset (commit 7c1a525). Alachua 2002 school: operating 6.646
mills, as published. County series may understate by up to ~0.1 mill where small debt or district levies
